summary: The customer called to complain about a rude representative who hung up on them and failed to explain a billing increase. The agent apologized, investigated the account, explained the one-time municipal tax adjustment, documented the feedback, and successfully resolved the customer's issue.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Marcus. How can I assist you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, respectful, and professional demeanor throughout the entire call.

evidence.text: You have every right to be upset, and I completely understand why you are frustrated.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent strongly and sincerely validated the customer's frustration regarding the poor treatment they received.

evidence.text: Ah, I see a one-time municipal tax adjustment was added last month, which explains the slight increase.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully identified the reason for the higher bill and clearly explained it to the customer, resolving the root issue.
